facts.fact: The communication technologies ministry's page refers to a National Strategy for the Development of very high speed broadband, under which it publishes FTTH technical terms of reference; the page gives no period and no successor, and has no date of its own, so the 2013 publication year (inferred from its annexed 2013 specifications) is used.
facts.system: Stratégie Nationale pour le Développement du très haut débit
